description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—across varying numbers of tokens, with the x-axis representing the "Number of Tokens" on a linear scale ranging from 200 to 900, marked at intervals of 200, and the y-axis showing a numerical metric from 10 to 40, marked at intervals of 10. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 and shows a steady increase, peaking at around 30 at 800 tokens before slightly declining. The red line, representing Library Documentation, begins at about 25, rises to a peak of approximately 32 at 800 tokens, and then declines. The yellow line, representing StackOverflow posts, starts at around 33, decreases steadily to about 12 at 800 tokens, and continues to drop to approximately 11 at 900 tokens. The green line, representing Github files, starts at about 27, increases to a peak of approximately 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines. All lines show a general trend of increase up to 800 tokens, with the exception of the yellow line, which shows a consistent decrease.
